The claim's named hook (before_prompt_build) is context-injection-ONLY with no block field, but the sibling before_agent_run supplies the blocking gate the verify question allowed for. The adapter already synthesizes api.on(...) handlers, so adding before_agent_run (block) + before_prompt_build (context) for UserPromptSubmit is the same pattern — implementable from docs alone.
